title: SvgFePointLight
responsibility: Renders the native fePointLight element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFePointLight.attributes
inputs.description: Native fePointLight attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFePointLight.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native fePointLight element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFePointLight
outputs.description: The actual native fePointLight element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
